releaseNotes:
Notes v1.8.164 (Build 336):
• Settings > Privacy > Chat History: keep everything in view like a normal chat app, or show only today with Recover all
• Daily cleanup clears the downloaded copies of older chats and media every night before 6 AM, or on the next open if the phone held it back
• Full cleanup now in Storage works on this phone only, and Recover all brings everything back
• Installing the app fresh is no longer blocked by Play Protect
• Dark mode text back in the original theme colour
